itemized.notes: ⚠ A FOURTH 2016 SHEET VARIANT — and the SECOND Schedule-B column vocabulary found in this chunk. The cover is the county-&-school-board blank ('Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5 & 20A-11-13', HEART of UTAH letterhead) with 'County & Local School Board Candidates' set vertically down the LEFT margin, but its inner sheets are strap-lined '2016 County & Local School Board CandidateS' — not the '2016 County Commission & Local School Board Candidate' strapline on Voeks 17bb61d5 and Bowen de1c36cb — and its SCHEDULE B COLUMN 2 IS HEADED 'Name/Nature of Expenditure', where Bowen's reads 'Expenditure' and Voeks's reuses Schedule A's 'Name of Contributor'. THREE Schedule-B headings and (with Frost 7dbce577) TWO cover blanks are therefore in circulation in ONE cycle and ONE seat. Read the headings off every page — nothing about the cover predicts the schedules (addendum F6). No variant seen so far prints a Purpose column. 4 pages, all classified by their own printed headings: p1 cover, p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B. FOLIATION: the Page __ of __ / Last Name / Date of Report block is printed on pp2-4 and left WHOLLY BLANK on all three, as on Bowen — page ordinals locate nothing here. ⚠ NOT ONE DATE ON EITHER SCHEDULE CARRIES A YEAR. All 14 itemized rows are month/day only ('6/24', '10/12', '7/9'...). Every one is kept VERBATIM and flagged needs_review=1 so the build blanks it — a year is never filled in from the report date, even though the report date (1 Nov 2016) and the cycle make the year obvious. This is the first filing in the chunk where the whole date column is year-less. PAGE-FACE NAME 'R. Nathan Ivie' (Office Seeking 'Ut. County Commissioner Seat C', party 'Rep.', residence Spanish Fork UT); he signs the verification 'Nathan Ivie'. index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face supplies it — and note the channel's own labels for this filer differ across his three 2016 filings ('Nathan Ivie' twice, 'R. Nathan Ivie' once). Report type: 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; amendment ticked 'No'; report date written '1 Nov 2016'. ⚠ THE SAME FILER IS ALSO A DONOR ELSEWHERE IN THIS CYCLE: 'Ronald Nathan Ivie (in-kind donation) 100.00' appears on Casey Voeks's 6/20/16 Schedule A (17bb61d5) at the same Benjamin UT address family. Recorded as an OBSERVATION across two documents; nothing was carried between them. PRIVACY: this filing is NOT redacted; full street lines and box numbers are published in the clear. Reduced to city/state at read time for contributions and dropped entirely for expenditures — no street line, box number or phone number reached this record. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: run on both sides and it CAUGHT SOMETHING on Schedule B — the filer uses the printed 'Mailing Address & Zip Code' column for the PURPOSE on all 8 rows and records no vendor address at all. The columns are assignable by content (the heading 'Name/NATURE of Expenditure' invites it), so the side is transcribed with purpose read from that column, not withheld. Schedule A's columns are unshifted. Row-index traps: the §A1 and §B5 controls passed on both sheets; there is one same-cell address wrap (contribution row 2) that does NOT consume a band, one ditto mark, one struck-and-corrected date and one struck-and-corrected address — none of which shifts an index.
